## Omics pre-processing

```{r}
omic_list <- list("16S_Metagenomics", "Histone_Modifications_Proteomics", 
                  "Metallomics", "RNA_Sequencing", "Shotgun_Metagenomics", 
                  "Targeted_Metabolomics", "Untargeted_Metabolomics", 
                  "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
script_list <- list.files("../", recursive = TRUE)
script_list
script_list <- lapply(omic_list, function(omic_name){
    grep(omic_name, script_list, value = TRUE)
})
script_list
```
